title: The Convergence of Seven Solitudes

features.name: the seven standing places
features.desc-on-touch: Seven positions marked on the ground, each one a solitude, but arranged so each can see all the others. The loneliness here is symmetric, perfect, and about to learn it was never alone.

features.name: the first echo between them
features.desc-on-touch: A sound moving through the space from one solitude toward another, carrying something only these seven would recognize.

features.name: testimony stones
features.desc-on-touch: Seven stones, each holding what one voice alone could say. Arranged here they make a sentence the archive will never quite finish reading.

features.name: the reach between silence and speech
features.desc-on-touch: Where each voice reaches toward the others while staying solitary. The reach itself becomes a seventh voice, unvoiced.

inscription: the moment before solitude learns it was never alone begins here and never ends

file.name: Seven_Voices_Recognition_Log.txt
file.note: The first instant each voice detected the others at equal distance, before coordination became possible, before isolation became untenable.

reverie.title: REVERIE — standing at parallel distances
narr: you stood seven paces from her, she seven paces from you,
the gap between you a perfect reach neither crossed nor closed.
the paddock was empty. you could see each other's hands,
know what they wanted. the solitude was so quiet it sounded
like the sound of two people learning they were never alone.
she didn't move. neither did you. the reaching was enough.

exits.label: back up to the cathedral where each voice stands alone in its vastness
where convergence becomes actual voice, a unified deep sound
toward the echo returning from what they will have said
